title: PPS channel: per recorded world k, K_k = C|k><k| / ||C|k>||, C = Tr_L U
doc_anchor: The PPS rule, for each world k
notes: Within-world rule is Hartle 1994 Eq. 5.6; PPS differs by not reweighting the recorded past.

title: Paradox-world fallback (C|k>=0): open loop sigma_k = Tr_L[U(|k><k| x 1/n)U^dag]; 'dctc' variant kept
doc_anchor: fall back to the open loop
notes: Default changed from D-CTC fixed point to open loop on 2026-11-27; justified by T8.2. Run --impact DEF-fallback before changing it again.

title: Pointer rule: worlds = pointer basis of the interactions that read A
notes: Candidate world rule 1 of 2 (history dependent).

title: State rule: worlds = eigenvectors of rho_A, averaged over degenerate eigenspaces
notes: Candidate world rule 2 of 2 (state complete). Neither is the default; results reported under both where they differ.

title: Mixed rule: (1 - c) Phi_pointer + c Phi_state, c = record overlap
notes: Preferred candidate for the readouts it covers (Theorem 9 decision).

title: Spacetime 'outside' = complement of the loop's causal future J+(M)
Classical reversible circuits: <y|C|x> = N_xy (number of consistent histories x -> y)
PPS is CPTP (sum K^dag K = 1), so no signalling Alice->Bob or Bob->Alice
scope: record basis must not depend on the state
notes: The state-dependent rule of DECOHERENCE.md is not covered (nonlinear).

title: H1': a world with a consistent history shows only consistent outcomes, P(y|x) = N_xy^2 / sum N^2; paradox worlds use the fallback; defined for every input
scope: classical reversible circuits, input recorded in the computational basis
notes: EXT-deutsch / EXT-fixedpoint only for the 'dctc' fallback variant.

title: Any U: if no history k -> y returns the loop unchanged in some loop basis, then P(y|k) = 0 (converse fails)
H2': recorded-world weights unchanged; with recorded messages the future is P_0 conditioned on consistency
Any U: P_PPS ~ |sum_m A_ym|^2 vs conditioned run ~ sum_m |A_ym|^2; they differ by interference terms
H3': controlled-form U (loop never acts on A) gives exactly ordinary QM, including zero-trace W_k
scope: controlled-form U; the controlled value must be recorded outside J+(M) (T4)

title: If the loop can never change A's output, U = V x W
If the loop never changes A's record in some basis, U is controlled in that basis
Theorem 3 covers exactly the record-preserving unitaries; a product U is not a loop input
doc_anchor: **A product is not a loop input.**
scope: PPS treats the loop's own (possibly weak) reading of A as perfect
notes: See OPEN-weak-loop-reading.

title: V reads A in some basis iff its operator-Schmidt A_i are normal and commute; the basis is their joint eigenbasis
If every interaction correlating A with the outside reads A in one basis, PPS in that basis is a fixed channel: no signalling, linear
notes: Three alternative definitions of the past are shown to signal (WaysToGetThePastWrong).

title: Incompatible readouts: the last readout fixes the record basis; no signalling via T0
notes: See OPEN-superposed-order.

title: Coarse readouts: block-wise rule is a fixed channel given the pre-readout state
scope: pure pre-readout state, all correlations from readouts
notes: Premise case (non-readout interactions) settled by T7.

title: Weak readouts: pointer and eigenbasis rules are safe and disagree; splitting on the outside signals
notes: Choice between the rules: T7 (under state completeness), T9 (mixed rule).

title: Spacetime: on every slice containing all of R or none of it, PPS leaves everything outside J+(M) as without the loop
scope: finite causal order; rank-one blocks; readout-only interactions before R
notes: Numerically to 1e-15 on 18 random spacetimes (1-3 spatial dimensions).

title: Readouts are strong decoherence (Gell-Mann-Hartle); generalized records must lie outside J+(M)
PPS is linear in the loop's operation iff its randomness is recorded outside J+(M); PPS is not a process matrix
doc_anchor: ### Is PPS linear in the loop
scope: single party; not checked with several parties
notes: Under the state rule (T7) a fair recorded coin is also nonlinear (0.02-0.06).

title: The uniqueness conjecture (a)-(d) is false: history counting N/sum N satisfies it and differs from PPS
doc_anchor: ### The conjecture as stated is false
notes: three_way_circuit: PPS 4/5, counting 2/3, D-CTC 3/4.

title: Under (U2)-(U4), L(U) = c Tr_L U; with (U1) the rule is PPS in every world with C psi != 0
scope: world-by-world rules; says nothing about the record basis or paradox worlds
notes: (U2) is the substantive assumption.

title: State completeness + no signalling imply the worlds depend on the state only through rho_A
Worlds = eigenvectors of rho_A; degenerate eigenspaces averaged
notes: Jumps at degenerate spectra (fair coin, Bell pair); not adopted as default.

title: Loop noise epsilon -> 0: PPS_eps -> PPS with trace distance <= eps / ((1-eps)||C|k>||^2); paradox worlds independent of eps
Basis-free loop noise is depolarizing, so the paradox-world output is the open loop
notes: Justifies DEF-fallback.

title: Computational power, one loop, recorded input: PP with the open fallback, PSPACE with 'dctc'
scope: one loop; algebraic gate set (Hadamard, Toffoli)
notes: Rests on three published complexity results; see OPEN-several-loops.

title: State-only rules jump at 1/d; single-basis history rules jump; the mixed rule is continuous on the weak-readout family
notes: EXT-idp is used only for the interpretation of 1 - c.
